verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical and share the same flaws. The dark logo now sits on navy without its white header band, so the brand nearly disappears. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow is moved below the headline, next to the CTA, which breaks the reading order. The headline and body text are tiny, and stray artifacts (a white bar top-right, a dash on the right edge) remain. B's headline is a hair larger, but that isn't enough to separate them.
